description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kuttikulama, Thirappane D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110573 (23/0885)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determination for multiple land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules listing land parcel numbers, extents, ownership details (all state-owned), and land classifications. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it concerns land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements.
